title: willughbeia auriculata
intro: Willughbeia auriculata, commonly known as the Auriculated Willughbeia or the Yellow-flowered Willughbeia, is a flowering plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate various health issues. Its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and phenolic compounds, are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties and have been the subject of scientific research.
